biotools.summary: Cheminformatics Microservice V3 is a web portal providing unified programmatic access to cheminformatics libraries like RDKit, CDK, and Open Babel. It offers an interactive web-based frontend for manipulating and analyzing chemical structures, supporting essential operations like structure editing and database search.
